gold.user: User A is a project manager who needs to redact sensitive information from a set of documents before sharing them with external stakeholders. They prepare the documents and submit them for redaction using the API.
gold.ideal: The API successfully processes the redaction request and returns a job ID for tracking the status of the redaction.

gold.user: User B is a compliance officer who submitted a redaction job earlier. They want to check the status of the redaction process to ensure it is completed before the documents are shared.
gold.ideal: The API returns the current status of the redaction job, indicating whether it is still processing, completed, or failed.
